description.en: The UNIX timestamp (in milliseconds) indicating the end time of the trajectory.

description.zh:
实例ID。<props="china"><ph>您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。</ph></props>

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

<props="china">实例的更多信息，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。</props>
description.en:
The instance ID. <props="china"><ph>You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>

><notice>
- If an ID value exists, you must pass this ID value; otherwise, the invocation will fail.
- If no ID value exists, you do not need to pass it.

></notice>

<props="china">For more information about instances, see [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>

description.zh:
是否结合地图进行位置纠偏。可取值：
- **0**：否，不进行轨迹纠偏。
- **1**：是，进行轨迹纠偏。
description.en:
Specifies whether to perform map-based location correction. Valid values:
- **0**: No. Trajectory correction is not performed.
- **1**: Yes. Trajectory correction is performed.

description.zh:
要查询设备所属产品的ProductKey。
ProductKey是物联网平台为新建产品颁发的全局唯一标识符。您可以在物联网平台控制台或调用[QueryProductList](~~69271~~)，查看当前账号下所有产品的信息。
description.en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the queried device belongs.  
ProductKey is a globally unique identifier issued by the IoT Platform for a newly created product. You can view information about all products under your account in the IoT Platform console or by invoking [QueryProductList](~~69271~~).
The UNIX timestamp (in milliseconds) indicating the start time of the trajectory.

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为50。
> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Queries per second (QPS) limit

The maximum queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account calling this API is 50.  
> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot gis-search-device-trace --map-match 0 --iot-instance-id iot-a000013l --end-time 1645071254000 --start-time 1645071254000 --product-key g3r0000Vjta --device-name mock_device_name --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot GisSearchDeviceTrace --region cn-hangzhou --IotInstanceId 'iot-a000013l' --EndTime 1645071254000 --StartTime 1645071254000 --MapMatch 0 --ProductKey g3r0000Vjta --DeviceName mock_device_name
